name: Crickets
notes: Cricket's Pub at 3339 El Cajon Blvd (work list gives 3333, same block) is confirmed Permanently Closed by Eater SD; Google Maps for 3333 El Cajon Blvd now returns Venice Pizza House, a differently-named successor. Permanently closed business, not a search gap.

name: Trisler's San Diego Wine Bar
notes: Confirmed permanently closed by Mapquest, Yelp and San Diego Reader (all say Permanently Closed / CLOSED), matching address 8555 Station Village Ln. trislers.com is now a parked domain for sale (screenshot of body text confirms 'this domain is for sale').

name: Far East Rock
notes: San Diego Reader confirms this Imperial Beach bar (992 Palm Ave, work list gives 987) operated under the name Far East Rock only in the 1980s; it was later renamed and by 2014 was the Salty Frog. Permanently closed under this name decades ago, differently-named successor at the address, not a search gap.

name: 3 Day Suit Broker
notes: Confirmed a men's discount suit and formalwear retailer (own site sells suits, dress shirts, tailoring), not a restaurant. Yelp categorizes it alongside Men's Wearhouse and other clothing stores. Business confirmed not to serve food.

name: Winners Circle
notes: Winner's Circle Resort is lodging (a motel/resort near Del Mar racetrack), not a restaurant. Its own site explicitly directs guests to 'Ranch 45 Local Provisions, right next door to Winners Circle Resort' for lunch - a separate, adjacent business, not on-site dining. No restaurant of its own found. Business confirmed not to serve food itself.

name: Plum Crazy Saloon
notes: 1060 Garnet Ave, Pacific Beach. Two independent sources agree it is permanently closed: Yelp ('CLOSED - Updated August 2026') and pubcrawls.com ('This venue appears to be permanently closed'). Permanently closed business.

name: Hong Kong Nite Club
notes: San Diego Union-Tribune news article confirms the storied Hong Kong bar (Broadway/10th Ave, East Village) closed permanently in 2020; a blog (davelandblog.blogspot.com) corroborates it was replaced by El Dorado Cocktail Lounge under Consortium Holdings, a differently-named successor at the address. Yelp separately marks it CLOSED. Permanently closed business, not a Yelp-only claim.
